title: The storefront page: browse, filter and fill a cart

scenes.title: Browse, filter and fill the cart

steps.say: The shop now has a page of its own. Every product is a card with its price and how many are left.
Some are running low, and one is gone. The vinyl record is out of stock, so it cannot be added.
A shopper can filter by category. Here, only the books.
Let's add a game to the cart.
The cart shows the game. The total is under fifty dollars, so shipping is four ninety-nine.
One more copy, and the order passes fifty dollars. Shipping becomes free.
Changed our mind about the game? Remove it.
The cart updates. With only the book left, we are under fifty dollars again, and shipping comes back.
Stock is checked too. This book has four copies.
On the fifth try, the page says there is no more in stock, and the cart stays as it was.
The cart also survives a reload.
